Summary: The HotpotQA dataset contains 112,779 Wikipedia-based Q&A pairs, split into training, development, and test sets. The test set includes 7,405 questions in both the distractor and full wiki settings. The dataset is divided into subsets such as train-easy, train-medium, and train-hard, with 18,089, 56,814, and 15,661 examples respectively. The development set has 7,405 examples for both hard multi-hop development and test sets in the distractor and full wiki settings. The dataset also includes a more comprehensive summary about data download, preprocessing, baseline model training, and evaluation on GitHub.
